paper_role: persistent device-loop architecture gate after straight-line XLA optimization barrier failed
question: Can a BF16 XLA While carry make predictor rounding executable while batching each contiguous A12 skip segment into one dispatch?

frozen_system.schedule: FLUX.1-dev 50-step dynamically shifted FlowMatch Euler sigmas
frozen_system.reference_contract: each prediction rounds to BF16 before each FP32 Euler update, and each updated latent rounds to BF16 before the next step
frozen_system.segment_input: fixed [9,2] FP32 coefficients plus [9,1] FP32 delta sigmas; short segments use zero-delta padding

gates.G1_compile_while: The candidate must compile/load on TP4 and input HLO must contain an XLA While/scan rather than nine unrolled straight-line copies.
gates.G2_single_step_exactness: Using the same segment graph with one active row and eight zero-delta rows, all 50 schedule states and final latent must be bit-exact to the frozen host contract.
gates.G3_segment_exactness: Using the six real multi-active A12 segment packets, every anchor state, every segment endpoint, and final latent must be bit-exact.
gates.G4_dispatch_contract: The complete cache schedule must use 1 initialize, 12 anchor, 6 segment, and 1 finalize entry point per rank; projected full resident request including staging and backbone is 33 entry points per rank.
gates.G5_scalar_boundary: A segment may receive only its fixed scalar coefficient/delta packet; no latent, anchor, or prediction tensor may be materialized on host between iterations.

decision.if_pass: Connect the scan segment entry point to the real staged FLUX backbone path, then run a quick paired H1e end-to-end A/B before freezing a full confirmation.
decision.if_fail: Reject the persistent scan path under the current runtime. Keep host-materializing A12 as deployable and continue only orthogonal H2/H3 characterization.
